Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Catholic theologian Charles Curran warned by Vatican for support of homosexuals 2. Sacramento city passes Gay Rights Bill 3. Indiana legislature kills several anti-gay bills 4. Fundraiser held to repeal the Texas sodomy law 5. Possible AIDS vaccine's effect on search for a cure COMMERCIAL: Commodore Plus 4 6. Rules governing the election of delegates in 1988 Democratic Convention changed to specifically include gays 7. Vermont rejects anti-discrimination move against gays by landlords 8. Gay Health Report: Study on course of HTLV infection, oral sex's riskiness, accommodation for gays visiting an Australia regatta COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 9. Outreach: Conversations with GMHC: Stash Santoro discusses GMHC's buddy program for those dying of AIDS 10. Sports Report, from Bowlmor Lanes 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: E-Z trim exercise equipment 2. Cabaret Beat, clips from a performance COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Interview with director Rosa von Praunheim about "A Virus Knows no Morals" COMMERCIAL: "The Gascon" by John Colin Penford 4. Dramatic reading of "More Lies" by Hektor Munoz COMMERCIAL: Jack Albertson for the Fund for Human Dignity 5. Review of the play "Immortal" by Felice Picano COMMERCIAL: Koos Fashion store COMMERCIAL: Michael Greer show announcement 6. Book Reviews: Gay/Lesbian Almanac by Jonathan Katz, Byron and Greek Love by Louis Crompton, Ganymede in the Renaissance by James Saslow, White Trash Cooking by Ernest Mickler
